reason: I already pay for my scheduler and Planable-type tools do the approval bit, so this is another subscription on top. The CSV export is nice but it's one more step in a Monday routine that already works.
objection: I don't believe it will sound like each client after 5 posts, and if I have to rewrite everything anyway I've paid for nothing. It also only says English or Lithuanian, and I don't know it works for my clients' languages.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where I run two real clients and the clients approve most posts untouched, plus a CSV that imports into my scheduler without me fixing columns.
